sections.notes: Put-in Dam Quarry Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Take-out Norfork #1 Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Cold tailwater below a U.S. Arkansas law: no glass containers in canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in sealed containers, carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat and use floating drink holders; children 12 and under wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).
